messages:
support_lead: Heads-up — FinBank opened a support escalation saying audit/log entries for their account are missing between 2026-03-10T01:12Z and 2026-03-10T01:45Z. They attached a couple of timestamps and are asking for an evidence window for compliance. @maria_security @raj_infra can you triage scope? :rotating_light:

aaron_oncall: Ack — oncall here. I see an alert from the HSM sync job around 2026-03-10T01:20Z that had retries. Pasting relevant lines from infra logs:
```
[2026-03-10T01:19:58Z] hsm-sync: start key rotation sync for region-eu-1
[2026-03-10T01:20:07Z] hsm-sync: upload failed, HTTP 500 KMS_PROXY
[2026-03-10T01:20:07Z] retrying (1/3)
[2026-03-10T01:20:21Z] hsm-sync: success, applied 0 keys
```
Looks like a short window of 20–25s transient failure then success.

maria_security: Thanks. Two quick questions: (1) Does the transient KMS/HSM failure block writes to the audit pipeline or just metadata replication? (2) Do we have any customer-facing retries/backfill for audit exports?

raj_infra: From the runtime side, audit events are enqueued to kafka and acked once forwarded to the audit-processor. HSM/KMS errors would only affect key-wrapping operations for export/evidence packs, not the raw audit log ingestion. But need to confirm if the export agent paused. Checking agent logs now.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-421 created (priority: P2) — "Audit delivery window question for FinBank". Pager duty oncall: aaron_oncall. Tags: kms,hsm,audit.

support_lead: FinBank is asking for a signed statement of affected timeframe and whether any customer data was exposed or dropped. They need ETA on a backfill or proof of delivery for their compliance team.

aaron_oncall: Quick repro attempts: I replayed a small batch through the audit-processor using the same config and it processed normally. No dropped messages in the topic offsets during that timeframe — offsets continuous. So ingestion looks intact.

maria_security: Good. If ingestion is intact, scope should be limited to export/key-wrapping and evidence generation. That still matters for compliance because customers request signed export manifests. We should confirm whether FinBank requested an on-demand export around the window. @legal_liz please weigh in on notification threshold for evidence availability windows.

legal_liz: If exports are delayed but no audit data loss, we typically notify the customer and provide an attestation plus remediation timeline. For regulated customers we often send a formal notice within 72 hours if their compliance workflow is impacted. Need to confirm impact before sending anything.

raj_infra: Found export-agent log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-10T01:18:45Z] export-agent: starting customer export request id=fb-9981
[2026-03-10T01:20:05Z] export-agent: failed to wrap archive with KMS: http 500
[2026-03-10T01:20:06Z] export-agent: queued for retry
[2026-03-10T01:20:30Z] export-agent: wrap success, upload complete, manifest signed
```
So the export was delayed ~25s and then succeeded. There is a manifest at s3://evidence/finbank/fb-9981/manifest.json.

support_lead: Great, can we produce the manifest and timestamped upload proof and confirm no other exports failed in that window? FinBank wants a short, clear timeline for their audit folder and confirmation that no records were missing.

aaron_oncall: I'll generate the evidence packet and include S3 PUT timestamps + KMS wrapping logs. ETA 30m. Also pulling cluster offsets to show no ingestion gap.

maria_security: Also attach KMS service audit entries and HSM RPC logs for the 01:12–01:45Z window. Important to show retries and final success to be transparent.

legal_liz: Draft comms: one-page statement saying: root cause was transient KMS proxy 500 causing a ~25s delay for an export. No audit ingestion loss. Export eventually completed and manifest uploaded. Offer to provide signed artifact and a timeline. Keep it factual and avoid speculative language. I'll draft a short template and share.

support_lead: Thanks. FinBank customer contact is Claire (claire@finbank.example). Once we have artifacts, I'll coordinate sending the attestation and ask if they want the signed manifest + full logs.

raj_infra: Quick checklist I'm running: 1) confirm export manifest integrity (sha256) 2) attach KMS wrap logs 3) show kafka offsets continuity 4) check for other exports during window -> none failed except fb-9981.

aaron_oncall: Uploading packet to secure-share. Link: https://secure-share.internal/evidence/fb-9981 (ACL: finbank only). Will ping here when complete.

sre-bot: Evidence packet uploaded at 2026-03-10T02:08:12Z by aaron_oncall.

support_lead: Nice. Next steps: legal_liz to finalize template, maria_security to review attached KMS/HSM logs for any anomalies, raj_infra to verify no other customers impacted, aaron_oncall to send evidence link to Claire after legal OK. I'll draft the customer message and post for review.

maria_security: Reviewed logs — only the fb-9981 export shows the transient 500s that retried and succeeded. No repeated failures across other regions. Marking sec-impact: low.

legal_liz: Draft ready and uploaded to the thread. Copy below for record: 
"We investigated your request and confirmed that during 2026-03-10T01:12Z–2026-03-10T01:45Z a transient KMS proxy error caused a short delay (~25s) to the export/evidence package for request id fb-9981. There was no loss of audit entries, and ingestion remained continuous. The signed manifest and full logs are attached for your review. If you require additional attestation, please let us know."

support_lead: Sending to Claire now with link. Will BCC compliance and include timeline + signed manifest.

aaron_oncall: Sent at 2026-03-10T02:15Z. Copy of email saved to incident.

support_lead: Closing follow-up here once FinBank confirms receipt. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
